text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪
That trendy lipstick that's been sold out forever...
I finally got to buy it!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Yukino, were you hoping to buy that too?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: "They released berry flavors last week, so everyone's been moving over to those."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!? No waaay!
The big city really is so hectic, it is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to keep up with how fast trends change,
Yukino Bijin became thoroughly disheartened.
